correctness.rationale: Orthogonality of the thirteen distinct cross-difference characters yields E=45+4Re(U)+4Re(V)+8Re(U conj(V)), and U,V range independently over the circle. The exact nonnegative deficit (|1+2conj(U)|−2)^2+4(|1+2conj(U)|+Re(V(1+2conj(U)))) proves the sharp lower endpoint 36, with equality exactly U=(-1±i√15)/4,V=conj(U); termwise real-part bounds give 61 and U=V=1. Connected phase space yields the interval, and algebraic-integer obstruction plus exhaustive small alphabets gives finite alphabet results. The independent Python checker completed 368 checks. Universal proof does not rely on sampled cases.

value.rationale: A minimal naturally symmetric five-sample Lee cross is an interpretable phase-only Fourier aperture, with two interacting midpoint identities and a genuine non-root-of-unity optimizer. The exact total sidelobe energy, all minimizer components, and sharp alphabet gap quantify feasible low-cost polyphase design versus free complex phases. Nontrivial exact value 36 and structural algebraic obstruction go beyond a generic correlation identity and do not merely rename a prior invariant.
